'''Ohali Soroc''' was one of the [[Quest Knights|Quest]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] sent by the [[New Jedi Order]] on the Quest for the [[Mortis monolith/Legends|Mortis monolith]].

==Biography==
In [[45 ABY]], she had gone missing when she was searching for the [[Mortis monolith/Legends|Mortis monolith]] that was necessary to prevent Abeloth's return.
